descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name meaning 'YHWH will establish,' referring to the king of Judah (son of Jehoiakim) who was exiled to Babylon in 597 BCE and later released by Evil-Merodach. The three clusters represent minor transliteration variants of the same person in identical grammatical frames (eng 'Yehoyakhin/Jehoiachin/Yehoyakin,' spa 'Joaquín/Yehoyakhin/Yehoyakin,' arb 'يَهُويَاكِينُ,' kor '여호야긴,' swa 'Yehoyakini,' hin 'यहोयाखीन/यहोयाकीन'). No semantic differentiation; purely orthographic/transliteration variation.
